messages:
lena: noticed ~96k events in ap-northeast with missing parent_ref for window 2026-05-19T03:40-04:10. top-level aggregates show a subtle drop for several tenants.
marco: any deploys flagged?
replay-bot: deploy-tracker: parent-linker service config roll at 2026-05-19T03:35 in ap-northeast. no crash but elevated 429s recorded between 03:40-03:55.
deepti: looks like consumer backpressure caused the parent attach step to skip attaching parent_ref on retries. downstream join then treated events as orphan.
josh: can we scope a lightweight reattach job instead of full recompute? route to replay-lane with dedupe and idempotency tag.
lena: prefer visible UX: small banner on affected dashboards saying "Reprocessing recent data (ETA ~60m)" rather than hiding change. product should know.
marco: agree. plan: 1) run targeted reattach for event_ids flagged by query, dedupe=true, concurrency=10. 2) throttle via queue-router: priority-burst=12% for 75m, CPU cap=15%. 3) enable banner via flag for affected tenants only. 4) schedule low-priority full recompute overnight if deltas >0.5%.
deepti: safety query results: ```sql
SELECT count(*) FROM telemetry.events
WHERE parent_ref IS NULL AND region='ap-northeast' AND created_ts BETWEEN '2026-05-19 03:40:00' AND '2026-05-19 04:10:00';
-- result: 96384
```
josh: that's manageable. I'll queue a job scoped to those event_ids and tag it `reattach-apne-20260519`. dedupe=true, backfill_id=reattach-apne-20260519.
replay-bot: replay-scheduler: job queued id=job-20260519-0042 owner=josh tag=reattach-apne-20260519
marco: router rule: if job.tag contains "reattach-apne-20260519" && now < job.start+90m then route -> priority-burst. adding TTL 2h.
console-bot: console: flag console.replay_banner.reattach_apne message: "Reprocessing recent data (ETA ~60m). Numbers may change." tenant_whitelist=[ten1,ten7,ten9].
lena: runbook note: if 429s > 5% or consumer lag > 2m then abort and fall back to low-priority recompute. jen (oncall) will be paged.
deepti: starting job job-20260519-0042 now. progress: shard=0/20 processed=512 skipped=0 errs=0
josh: mid-run update: 8/20 shards done, processed=39k deduped=82. no 429 spikes; write QPS steady.
replay-bot: job log: `shard=12 processed=2048 deduped=1 errs=0`
marco: monitoring looks clean. we'll keep priority-burst for first 75m then auto-disable.
console-bot: badge enabled for tenants ten1/ten7/ten9.
lena: good. recapping owners: josh -> run & monitor job, marco -> temporary router rule & TTL, deepti -> safety checks & abort criteria, console-bot -> banner & badge enable. I'll draft a short note to product after reconciliation.
josh: job completed job-20260519-0042 processed=96384 deduped=278 errs=0. reconciliation: aggregates back within expected ranges; diffs <0.04% for monitored metrics. disabling priority-burst.
marco: removed router rule and TTL expired.
deepti: verified consumer 429s stayed <1% during run.
console-bot: banner flag auto-removed after 45m. UI badge removed after reconciliation.
lena: follow-ups: marco will open PR to add a small circuit-breaker in parent-linker to fail fast and emit metric when 429 > 3% for >30s, josh will add replay job link to incident note, deepti will schedule low-priority full recompute as contingency.
marco: filing postmortem stub -> /incidents/2026-05-19-parent-reattach-draft.md
lena: thanks all — nice scoped run, low noise, product informed.
